approval_required_for: Any change to checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, testbench semantic contract, numeric policy or tolerance, including any proposal to derive tolerance from DUT output.

Any modification of the exact user-supplied board wrapper, its discovered source identity, interface ABI, compile authority, or Vivado export selection when evidence cannot bind the existing identity.
Any pipeline architecture, memory-layout, loader-address-map, or major template change beyond the bounded harness/instrumentation repair.
Any lower-layer reopening or revalidation; it requires a fresh current hash-bound contradiction record against a named certified invariant.

observations: real_tool.case_multilayer_pipeline executed and failed because all-target-layer Transformer-block tensor-to-loader-to-DUT coverage and hash-verified multilayer harness sources are missing. This is a verification-capability failure, not evidence of a leaf, kernel, AXI, DDR, numeric, ordering, liveness, or RTL defect.

functional_sim=fail is an unsatisfied aggregate: board_tb.sv is missing and VCS, its evidence analyzer, AXI/deadlock diagnostics, and downstream board gates are not_run behind multilayer-pipeline and AXI/DDR prerequisites. The historical VCS diagnosis is explicitly historical_only and cannot be used as a current hardware-localization trace.

The current hierarchy records all operator-leaf and connected single-transformer-layer gates as passed. Their live certificates are hash-identified, and the connected kernel's verified behavior is an elastic variable-latency token pipeline with preserved boundary order and required cross-token overlap. No current hash-bound trace contradicts either certificate, so no lower-layer backtrack is authorized.

The prior ready-to-apply r5 testbench-only probe may be reused only as source-bound, non-invasive observation instrumentation in the newly generated board testbench. It does not satisfy loader coverage, DUT weight-consumption proof, or functional correctness by itself.

sacg_memory_truth is authoritative: 10 active board-scope contamination barriers and 4 open board-scope retry requests remain. The barriers include rejected discovery-failed and multilayer-pipeline-failed lineages; they remain trust barriers even though the current hierarchy records case_board_interface_discovery=pass. There are no open current-scope backtrack requests.
The conditional design-team router made no specialist split. Its no-split result and the prior review agree with the evidence classification but do not replace the failed real-tool result.
proposed_actions: Create a content-addressed, exact-wrapper-bound board verification candidate that supplies complete Transformer-block tensor hashing, immutable target-model expected outputs, loader-to-DUT binding requirements, board_tb.sv, and an authorized VCS compile plan; rerun multilayer-pipeline and AXI/DDR prerequisite gates.

After prerequisite gates pass, execute the real board-wrapped VCS replay using the identical checkpoint, stimulus, numeric policy, and exact wrapper. Capture per-tensor DUT consumption evidence and current ingress/stage-0/egress/output-frontier trace data.

If that replay fails, perform CCTG-guided current-board boundary localization before any code patch. Reopen a lower layer only if a fresh trace directly contradicts a named certified invariant with required core-start, ingress, egress, causal-boundary, and certificate evidence.

Only after the real replay and all remaining board gates pass, submit the new content-addressed Stage7 candidate for deterministic SACG retry/trust-barrier reconciliation. Do not self-clear prior rejected artifacts or promote to backend in this repair step.
risks: Model and shape risk: a manifest may omit a required Transformer-block tensor or confuse target-layer indexing; sampled weights, disk presence, or a loader declaration are not complete-scope coverage or DUT-consumption evidence.

Numeric-policy risk: expected results must be produced by target-model inference on the identical immutable checkpoint and stimulus. Tolerance values must remain current-run values or authorized frozen defaults and must never be derived from DUT output.

Data-order, memory, and runtime risk: the loader, DDR image, tensor address map, transfer counts, and layer traversal can disagree while static source artifacts appear plausible; require executed consumption and ordering evidence.

Board-integration risk: the generated board testbench and VCS plan must bind the exact user-supplied wrapper, source hashes, and real Vivado export authority. A simplified wrapper or guessed compile command is prohibited.

A future output-frontier stall would only localize the next observation. Independent AXI or prefetch progress is not output/lifecycle progress and cannot establish a root cause or reopen the certified kernel.
No board-scope candidate is trusted or promotable while the active SACG barriers and retry requests remain unreconciled.

constraints: Repair only the current board-layer verification/harness capability before requesting hardware localization.
Accelerator semantic scope is Transformer blocks only; exclude embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, sampling, and other model-tail tensors from DUT coverage and golden boundaries.
Checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, tolerance, testbench contract, and exact wrapper/source hashes remain immutable throughout this repair loop.

Retain all 10 active same-scope contamination barriers and all 4 open same-scope retry requests as downstream-consumption blockers until a distinct, content-addressed passing candidate is checked and reconciled.
Reuse certified operator-leaf and elastic single-layer invariants; unequal stage latency is not a failure and no lower-layer revalidation is authorized absent a current named contradiction.
edges: immutable checkpoint -> complete Transformer-block tensor catalog -> hash-bound loader -> DUT consumption evidence
exact user-supplied board wrapper and Vivado export identity -> board_tb.sv and VCS compile plan -> AXI/DDR functional replay
target-model reference for identical checkpoint and stimulus -> immutable numeric comparison -> board semantic evidence
current board boundary trace -> current-layer localization; lower-layer reopening only on an explicit hash-bound contradiction

Repair the current board verification capability and rerun current-layer tools; do not reopen certified leaf or single-layer scopes and do not promote to backend or board runtime.
